claims.statement: Thinking is enabled by default and default effort is high. Supported effort levels are low, high and max. Compatibility inputs map minimal→low, medium→high, xhigh→high and ultra→max.

In thinking mode, temperature, presence_penalty and frequency_penalty have no effect; top_p below 0.95 is treated as 0.95. Tool follow-up requests must return prior reasoning_content or the API returns HTTP 400.
